selection.brightness: Apparent Johnson V magnitude as seen from Earth; smaller number is brighter; not absolute luminosity.
selection.namedScope: All current IAU WGSN CSN names plus HYG traditional proper names and curated named deep-sky landmarks. Not every informal name ever used.
selection.unresolvedDistances: Objects remain searchable but not navigable. HYG sentinel100000pc is never treated as a physical distance.
selection.namedDeepSky: All OpenNGC Common names (132 rows) plus familiar M101; original famous landmarks retained; arbitrary nearest ATNF and numbered-galaxy filler removed.

curatedCosmicLandmarks.references: Individual source URLs, position assumptions, extent definitions and candidate status retained per record.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.distance: Present-epoch comoving distance integrated from redshift in common flat LCDM H0=70, OmegaM=0.3, OmegaLambda=0.7; radiation neglected. Light-travel time is separately integrated, never used as distance.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.nearbyVoid: Local Void anchor: Cosmicflows-3 Lacerta-2.4 SG XYZ=(22,-9,22) Mpc, transformed using the Lahav/de Vaucouleurs supergalactic basis.
curatedCosmicLandmarks.display: Illustrative contours; widths or central directions without measured footprints are explicitly identified. No decorative filler.

fullCatalog.search: Lazy 39.7 MB compact worker index; 100 results initially
fullCatalog.map: Orthographic Galactic XY plus explicit host-local views; one spatial binary tree (no radial bands); max256 leaf rows, 48 cached tiles, 32 view nodes, 4 concurrent loads, 8000 target streamed objects plus fading union <=16000; weighted stable representatives; observed filament polylines; immutable versioned data root
fullCatalog.uncertainty: Formal policy v4: HYG sigma is attached only to the matching HIP2007/HIP1997 solution; unmatched adopted distances retain unknown sigma. Bounded compact GC hosts use published distance/error and tidal radius; galaxy membership alone never supplies depth.  bounded point estimates only; no sentinels or model bounds. Field reported relative error <=0.5, ATNF PX significance >3 and DM-model ratio <=2. Host-local model envelope <=0.5 of its reference diameter; common host-distance error is correlated, not independent scatter. Full definitions in docs/catalog.md.
fullCatalog.systems: 461 catalog groups; shared-distance estimates explicitly labelled. Distance conflicts suppress orbital diagrams; Cygnus X-1/HDE226868 use the published system distance. Local shared display transform prevents t-SNE separation of close components.
fullCatalog.fictionalStars: Known nearby stars preferred; otherwise explicitly fictional departure stars at every mapped destination, persisted with expedition.

nearbyGalaxyStars.distance: M31 V1/AF and LMC R136a1: justified inclined-disk model. HD5980: atlas-only, unresolved depth. OGLE Clouds: individual period-Wesenheit distances.

fullCatalog.confirmedSystems: data-tools/confirmed-systems.json: published physical relationships override conflicting individual distance estimates; common distances remain explicitly approximate.

galaxyMembers.selection: LGGS Mm=1; PHAT main table2 only; M33 SNR Conf=yes
galaxyMembers.model: Measured directions; disk-ray intersections for massive stars/gas; unaged PHAT clusters atlas-only, no individual depth; M33 mirror ambiguity included.

magellanicCepheids.method: Individual published period-Wesenheit distances and errors; no common host shell or disk approximation. Host-local display uses an orthographic sky view of true 3D coordinates, rotated to align the observed population with its schematic outline; physical depth remains in p3.

MCXC-II.selection: All entries searchable; map only S/SP redshift types and z>=.002. M500 is an extended aperture mass, not a point mass.

SDSS-Superclusters.selection: Main sample adaptive threshold only; centre of mass RA2/DE2/Dist2. Edge/confidence retained.

SDSS-Filaments.selection: All observed filaments and all source spine points; no mock galaxies/fictional geometry. Independent sky-coordinate validation stored in audit.

SDSS-Voids.selection: Observed DR7 Type1 comoving catalogues, one tracer sample per nonoverlapping redshift interval; Type2/basic and other segmentation versions excluded. Edge flags retained. DR11 archive unavailable, not imported.

Cosmicflows-4.selection: All individual table2 distance moduli; corrected 2023/CDS release, not flawed August 2022 tables. Relative upper/lower distance error >50% retained atlas-only.

Nearby-Galaxies.selection: All objects searchable. Membership-only, Hubble-only and untyped txt distances atlas-only; individual measured/model distances eligible. Holmberg angular sizes retained.

GLADE+.selection: Explicit subset of full 23-million-row source: Type G, B<=15.5, f_dL=3 (spectroscopic), zhelio>.002. Other rows not claimed imported; no photometric redshift placement.

Gaia-Clusters.selection: Updated 2024 J/A+A/686/A42, Type o/m/g/d only, CST>=5 and CMDCl50>=.5. Rejected r types excluded; distant d retained without a bound/unbound claim; reported distance error >50% atlas-only. Not all Gaia stars.
